title: Projection mate arrow transport along a scheme-isomorphism square
statement: Let $X,Y,X',Y'$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a common morphism universe $w$ for $X,Y$ and a common independently chosen universe $w'$ for $X',Y'$. Use the recorded derived tensors [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback], and direct images [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Let $f:X\to Y$, $g:X'\to Y'$, $e_X:X'\cong X$, and $e_Y:Y'\cong Y$ satisfy $g;e_Y=e_X;f$. For any supplied adjunction $p:Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$, tensor-pullback natural isomorphism $t$, and $M\in D_{QCoh}(Y)$, $L\in D_{QCoh}(X)$, there exist an equivalence $e:D(Y')\simeq D(Y)$, an adjunction $q:Lg^*\dashv Rg_*$, a tensor-pullback natural isomorphism $s$, and $N\in D_{QCoh}(Y')$, $E\in D_{QCoh}(X')$ such that $e$ applied to the $q,s,N,E$ projection mate is isomorphic as an arrow to the $p,t,M,L$ projection mate. A projection mate is the homEquiv transpose of the tensor-pullback comparison followed by identity tensor the counit. No open restriction, homology conclusion, compactness or projection-formula invertibility hypothesis is part of this assertion.

source.place: Tag 08EU, lemma-cohomology-base-change, first sentence of proof: scheme-isomorphism comparison in the affine-local reduction

proof.text: Apply exists_scheme_iso_derived_equivalence to eY and eX to obtain a,b and their localization factorizations. Apply schemeIso_derived_functor_comparisons to obtain the binary tensor comparisons tau_a,tau_b and the natural isomorphisms alpha : a;Lf* = Lg*;b and beta : Rg*;a = b;Rf*. These are the only remaining geometric comparisons.

Construct q from the explicitly transported Hom equivalence: a(q.homEquiv(k)) = p.homEquiv(alpha.hom;b(k));beta.inv. Its inverse is lifted through full faithfulness of b. Naturality of alpha and beta proves the two Hom-equivalence naturality laws and Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv gives q. It follows that alpha.hom;b(q.counit) = Lf*(beta.hom);p.counit. After composing with b construct s from alpha.inv, Lf*(tau_a), t, alpha tensor alpha, and tau_b.inv; fullyFaithfulCancelRight lifts this natural isomorphism to the primed categories. All of these constructions and identities are proved in private categorical helpers in the item, with no holes.

For arbitrary primed coefficients N,E form c = tau_a;(id tensor beta) and d = beta;Rf*(tau_b);Rf*(alpha.inv tensor id). Expand the constructed q.homEquiv and b(s), cancel the inverse comparison factors, use naturality of tau_b to move the counit, substitute the transported counit identity, and use naturality of t. This proves c.hom;pi = a(pi_prime);d.hom. Arrow.isoMk gives the first arrow isomorphism. This entire calculation is proved as transport_mate_square and transportMateIso.

Set N to a.inverse(M) and E to b.inverse(L) in the quasi-coherent subcategories, using scheme_iso_derived_inverse_preserves_qcoh and the localization factorizations. Prove the p,t projection mate is natural in both coefficients using t, p.counit and p.homEquiv naturality. Apply this to a and b counits to obtain the coefficient arrow isomorphism, and compose it with the first arrow isomorphism. No projection-mate invertibility, bounds or geometric finiteness assumptions are used.

proof_origin.place: J2: scheme-isomorphism part of the affine-local reduction. The geometric comparison construction is isolated; the transported Hom equivalence, tensor comparison, mate-square equation and coefficient naturality are proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem projectionMate_schemeIso_transport
    (X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y'.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X' ⟶ Y') (eX : X' ≅ X) (eY : Y' ≅ Y)
    (hcomm : g ≫ eY.hom = eX.hom ≫ f)
    (p : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅
      (derivedPullback f).prod (derivedPullback f) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) :
    ∃ (e : schemeDerivedCategory Y' ≌ schemeDerivedCategory Y)
      (q : derivedPullback g ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage g)
      (s : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y') ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
        (derivedPullback g).prod (derivedPullback g) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X'))
      (N : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y') (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X'),
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk (e.functor.map (q.homEquiv (N.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj E.obj)
        ((derivedPullback g).obj N.obj ⊗ E.obj)
        (s.hom.app (N.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj E.obj) ≫
          (𝟙 ((derivedPullback g).obj N.obj) ⊗ₘ q.counit.app E.obj)))) ≅
      Arrow.mk (p.homEquiv (M.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj)
        ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj ⊗ L.obj)
        (t.hom.app (M.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj) ≫
          (𝟙 ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj) ⊗ₘ p.counit.app L.obj))))
